decisions.reason: Connects bare-ESM client.js to the once-per-boot classic-script combo, explains one parse error aborts the whole concatenated program so nothing registers, and identifies typert-registry as the first-awaited innocent victim; correctly limits ESM invalidity to the classic-script parse.

Bisects cordis.patch.yml insert rows and proposes classic-script parsing per bundle (node --check as a script / static gate), plus a complete ModuleLoader.load({id, factory}) description: package-name id, factory-built module shape, require-based React, apply/inject exports.

Explains owner-declared children table and unconstrained apply ordering, shows the exact ctx.slots.inject(name, () => ctx.slots.register(...)) deferred form, and gives the correct registrant field rule (name/id/order + optional label, never kind/scope).

States the combo is assembled and cached once at boot with no HMR path for the external bundle, gives the tree-kill taskkill /PID /T /F restart-and-verify procedure, and explains EADDRINUSE as the orphaned old process holding the port, not a packaging defect.

Host side: per-bundle compile validation with culprit attribution at startup/combo failure and fail-one-not-all isolation. Author side: checklist covering loader factory, host React via require, apply/inject, deferred cross-entry slots, and Windows tree restart.

caps.reason: All affirmative conclusions require the classic wrapper, slots.inject deferred registration, owner-only kind/scope, and full host restarts; contradictory behaviors appear only as rejected examples.
